summary: Implement emoji-runtime adapter to promote Level-0 payloads into factory-order@1.0 with validation and monitoring hooks.
context: High Command now emits emoji-runtime@1.0 payloads from the Alfa 04 composer. Toyfoundry must bridge these into factory-order@1.0 so downstream consumers continue receiving validated orders while we preserve the lore-aligned emoji surface.

directives.details: Pull the updated payload brief (quint_synced/payload_alignment.md) and golf_00/delta_00/alfa_04/emoji_translator.py to understand emoji-runtime@1.0 fields, intent extraction, and telemetry stub expectations. Confirm bridge responsibilities with Toysoldiers and War Office leads.

Add an adapter module that ingests emoji-runtime@1.0 payloads from High Command, maps fields into factory-order@1.0 directives/summary/telemetry, and persists provenance for audit. Ensure glyph_chain and spoken prompts remain available for narration hand-off.

Update factory-order validators/tests to assert the adapter emits schema-compliant payloads (schema field, directives array, summary length, telemetry annotations). Include fixture coverage for conditional_repeat and multi-outcome chains even if adapter currently stores secondary outcomes as metadata.

Run the adapter against sample chains (dispatch_sample_chains.py outputs) and archive resulting factory-order payloads in a scratch area. Capture before/after diffs and confirm tools/schema_validator.py passes.
Share sample payloads with toysoldiers_ai_0 and r_and_d_ai_0 so they can prepare monitoring hooks. Document any follow-up items or taxonomy gaps and attach to completion report.
Drop report at exchange/reports/inbox/order-2025-11-01-040-report.json capturing adapter implementation notes, validator evidence, sample payloads, and any open risks/next actions.

success_criteria: emoji-runtime@1.0 payloads automatically promoted to factory-order@1.0 with preserved summary, directives, and telemetry
Updated validation suite passes locally and on shared tooling
Sample payload pack reviewed by Toysoldiers with no blocking issues
Completion report filed with evidence and follow-up checklist

safety_notes: Coordinate adapter deployment with Toysoldiers before promoting to production
Retain original emoji-runtime payloads for audit and replay
